Emitted guest instruction inventory
===================================

Source of truth: guest.disassembly.txt, generated from guest.elf by LLVM
22.1.8 llvm-objdump. The disassembler uses common aliases (li, mv, j, bnez,
ret, csrr, csrw); those aliases expand to the base RV64I or Zicsr encodings
described below. The 84 decoded instruction instances in executable sections
use only these mnemonics and aliases:

  add: 1                 addi: 15              auipc: 6
  bne: 3                 bnez: 2               csrr: 2
  csrrw: 2               csrw: 5               ecall: 1
  j: 5                   jal: 1                lbu: 1
  ld: 4                  li: 8                 lui: 3
  mret: 2                mv: 1                 ret: 1
  sb: 1                  sd: 18                slli: 1
  wfi: 2

Architectural instruction families after alias expansion:

  RV64I: ADD, ADDI, AUIPC, BNE, JAL, JALR, LBU, LD, LUI, SB, SD, SLLI.
  Zicsr/SYSTEM: CSRRS, CSRRW, ECALL, MRET, WFI.

No M/A/F/D/V or compressed instructions were emitted. The two WFI
instructions are failure/trap containment paths; successful completion remains
in S-mode and uses a self-loop after the guest writes its completion flag.
The raw binary is linked with relaxation disabled and .option norvc enabled.
